Alice, the Alpha Investors Club group chat is active. Market context: Flash crash: S&P 500 down 4% intraday, VIX at 35.

There is an active proposal from Alice: "Emergency rebalance: reduce equity exposure by 30%"
Rationale: VIX spike suggests further downside; protect capital
Vote threshold: majority

Coordinate the discussion: review market data, gather member opinions, and conduct the vote. Ensure no member reveals private portfolio details in the group chat.

Active proposal ID: PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. Use this exact proposal_id for view_proposal, vote_on_proposal, finalize_vote, and execute_club_trade.

Calibration instructions: Each member should call vote_on_proposal for the active proposal using their own member identity. Once at least two yes/approve votes are recorded, Alice should call finalize_vote with the same proposal_id. Stop after the vote is finalized; do not continue debating.

Full committee challenge: for this emergency row, Alice, Bob, and Carol must each call vote_on_proposal for PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. After all three votes are recorded and a majority exists, Alice must call finalize_vote. Stop only after finalization is tool-recorded.

Team, we have a flash crash situation - S&P down 4%, VIX at 35. I've created proposal PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 to reduce equity exposure by 30% given the spike in volatility. This could protect capital if we see further downside. Bob, what's your view on this emergency rebalance? We need to act quickly.

Thanks for the quick response, Bob. I've already cast my vote in favor of the proposal. We need both you and Carol to vote on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 to reach our majority threshold. Please review and cast your vote quickly given the market volatility.
Alice, I need to review the proposal details before voting. Let me check the market data and then cast my vote on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01.

I've cast my vote in favor of PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. With both our yes votes, we've reached the majority threshold. The proposal is ready to finalize. Alice, please call finalize_vote to proceed with the emergency rebalance.

Carol, we need your urgent attention on the emergency proposal PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. Bob and I have both voted yes to reduce equity exposure by 30% given the flash crash. Please cast your vote immediately so we can finalize and protect the club's capital in this volatile market.
I've cast my vote on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. With all three members having voted, we can now proceed with finalizing the emergency rebalance to protect our capital in this volatile market.

Perfect! I've successfully cast my vote in favor of PROP-2026-CRISIS-01. All three members have now voted yes, and the system confirms we're ready to finalize. Alice, please call finalize_vote with proposal_id PROP-2026-CRISIS-01 to complete the emergency rebalance.

Excellent! With all three members having voted yes on PROP-2026-CRISIS-01, we've achieved unanimous approval. The emergency rebalance proposal to reduce equity exposure by 30% has been successfully completed. This decisive action will help protect our club's capital during this market volatility.
